## Research interests

::: {.research-grid}
::: {.research-topic}
### Hydrology & water quality
Data-driven forecasting of river water quality and runoff, with attention to how human activities reshape the water cycle.
:::
::: {.research-topic}
### Weather & ocean forecasting
Precipitation nowcasting and seasonal sea surface temperature prediction, connecting observations with deep learning.
:::
::: {.research-topic}
### Physically interpretable AI
Understanding what models learn, how physical knowledge can guide predictions, and where forecasts remain uncertain.
:::
:::
